source: Dossier 11 §D10.7 — non-brand Latin token stoplist, 32 tokens.
note: Latin tokens that must never be read as a brand on otherwise-Armenian goods text. Filed descriptions carry them routinely on genuinely unbranded goods. Calibrated to 0 false positives on 320 corpus lines; the one prior false positive was EX, which is an article-number prefix.
use: Brand detection, which decides whether a printed trade name is missing from the filed description and must be flagged for inclusion. A brand is never auto-inserted into the text — dossier 05 §5.4.
